notes: Used for everything from chopping food to cutting hair or fabric. It is a very versatile action verb.
Do not confuse with 'หั่น' (hàn), which is specifically for slicing food into smaller pieces, or 'เฉือน' (chuean), which is for slicing off a thin layer.
